ValidationRule.description: Field Product Category Mandatory for iptv to dependent Product Family
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Product_Category__c , "IPTV"), OR( ISPICKVAL( Family , "Display"), ISPICKVAL( Family , "Reward"), ISPICKVAL( Family , "Performance"), ISPICKVAL( Family , "Messaging") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Product Category for IPTV: Creative Ads, TVC, Programmatic Ads, Blocking Channel, In House Production, Off Air Activation, OTT Digital Advertising.
